decisions.decision: Freeze subtractive-55-v1 instead of calling host System.Random or reusing prototype Park-Miller. Preserve seeded Next(), Next(max), Next(min,max) and NextDouble consumption/scaling; signed Int32 seed initialization wraps explicitly. Validate 55 values in [0,2147483646], at least one nonzero, next-write index in [0,54].
decisions.evidence: RandomTests literal independent Python recurrence vectors and supplementary seeded .NET comparisons across table wraps.

decisions.decision: Replace each source static generator with a named world-owned stream, preserving sharing within source generators. Move all ten authoritative stream states into saves. This deliberately adds repeatable continuation to source-unsaved development/construction/etc. No new correlations by merging source generators, no per-entity split.
decisions.evidence: RandomTests interleaved subsystems/sessions, immutable capture/restore, scheduler rebinding and real checkpoint restart.

decisions.decision: Stream-bank version 1 derives each stream seed from SHA-256 of UTF-8 freetrain.random-streams.v1 + LF + invariant signed decimal root seed + LF + exact stream ID (no trailing LF); little-endian first 4 digest bytes masked with 0x7fffffff. IDs, encoding, algorithm, initialization and API consumption form the versioned contract. No string.GetHashCode, environment seed, lazy registration or request-order seed assignment. Reference root seed is 0.
decisions.evidence: Ten literal seed-derivation vectors and independent initial-state Save 4 fixture.

decisions.decision: Save 4 / reference-spatial-3 persist complete random bank alongside clock; protocol 3 and asset-free pack/content hash unchanged. Per subsequent owner direction during rapid slice iteration without a save-game corpus, support only the current format: reject Saves 1/2/3 with incompatibleSave, preserve current world/files, and retain no older-format parser or upgrade. Unknown bank version/algorithm gives incompatibleSave; malformed bank gives invalidSave before world replacement.
decisions.evidence: Strict current schema and C# codec; retired Save 2/3 fixtures are used only for rejection tests. Client schema, HTTP checkpoint and browser upload rejection/confirmation tests.

decisions.decision: No authoritative draws in browser rendering, read-only queries, save/capture, pause changes, or empty reference-clock advancement. UI selector generators remain transient local proposals, creek remains operation-local. Source RandomEx helpers and exact consumer call order, bounds, arithmetic/anomalies and no-candidate branches must be bound and verified in P7/P8; they are not implemented gameplay here. RandomEx.Next2DExt has asymmetric loop logic and halfRange=0 can loop forever: retain source difference for P8 rather than silently changing it.
decisions.evidence: Source consumer hashes and P1 tests for empty-clock, creek and independent-session consumption.

localization.review: No new control, label, help text or random-generator name is exposed. Existing invalidSave/incompatibleSave English and Japanese keys are reused; no untranslated random errors enter product flows. Source random selector UI labels remain with P2/P7/P8/P9 consumer translations. Browser regression includes narrow Japanese and English save errors.

limits: Source-derived algorithm/ownership review; no stable desktop-runtime comparison or historical binary RNG-state import.
Reference world contains no gameplay random consumers; all consumer gameplay/optional packs and full-city continuations remain later slices.
P1-04 entity/footprint/pack contracts and native/device gates remain open.
